scientific_integrity: Exact theorem derived analytically from a classical Bloch model; finite numerical cross-checks do not prove universal statements. The first-public-date records the 2008 antecedent rather than claiming the theorem appeared there.
scientific_limitations: Unpinned linear nearest-neighbor alternating-mass chain with a common positive spring constant and a strictly positive nonzero mass contrast
Equal-mass limit is a band degeneracy; no differentiable optical-branch claim exactly at degeneracy
No statement about heat conductivity, damping, disorder, finite-size transport or experimental data
Historical-priority search does not exclude all older or inaccessible literature; independent audit not performed
title: Unique fastest optical phonons and a two-thirds mass-contrast cusp in a diatomic harmonic lattice
